target.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
The AI safety event types defined in #107176 need to be wired to the existing OTEL and Prometheus exporters so operators can observe them in their telemetry stacks. Without exporter mappings, the events are emitted but invisible.

## Evidence
- `extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service-events.ts` — switch/case dispatcher; new cases added for all 6 ai_safety.* types
- `extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service-recorders-ai-safety.ts` (new file) — recorder factories per event type
- `extensions/diagnostics-prometheus/src/service.ts` — unified counter `openclaw_ai_safety_events_total{event_type,severity,channel}` with low-cardinality labels only (Prometheus 2048-series cap respected)
- `assignOtelAiSafetyAttributes()` in `service-attributes.ts` mirrors the existing `assignOtelSecurityAttributes()` pattern
- `tool_policy.decision` and existing `tool.execution.blocked` non-overlap documented in JSDoc
- Depends on: #107176

## Evidence — Clawsweeper re-review fixes (2026-07-14)

**Provenance fix:** the six AI safety OTEL recorders in `service-recorders-ai-safety.ts` previously discarded `DiagnosticEventMetadata`. Each recorder now receives the metadata and attaches `openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted` (from `metadata.trusted`) so operators can distinguish core-trusted emissions from plugin-emitted ones. The attribute is named `emitter_trusted` to avoid colliding with the pre-existing `openclaw.ai_safety.trusted` label on `external_content.consumed`, which describes content-source trust, not emitter provenance. The dispatcher in `service-events.ts` passes `metadata` through for all six `ai_safety.*` cases, matching the existing security-event recorder pattern.

**Scope fix:** verified this branch introduces no `src/plugin-sdk/diagnostic-runtime.ts` changes of its own — the SDK type exports visible in the stacked diff come solely from the base contracts commits (#107176). No duplication to remove.

Local verification on this branch: `extensions/diagnostics-otel/src/service.test.ts` — 107 tests passed; `pnpm tsgo:extensions` clean.

**4-PR series design note:** the security boundary is deliberate across the stack — #107176 defines the contracts and excludes AI safety events from the untrusted `emitDiagnosticEvent()` surface (type- and runtime-gated); this PR wires exporters and preserves emitter provenance; #107187 adds the only plugin-facing emission surface, gated by manifest `safetyEventTypes`; #107192 adds observability surfaces. Untrusted path gated, trusted path only.

**OTEL note:** full end-to-end OTEL integration proof requires a running collector, which is not available in CI; recorder behavior is covered by the extension unit tests above.

### Live simulation output
<details>
<summary>Terminal output — emitting all 6 event types through trusted path (re-run 2026-07-14 after rebase onto upstream/main)</summary>

Run: `npx tsx scripts/simulate-ai-safety-events.ts` on `feat/ai-safety-exporters` (script committed in that branch). Stages: trusted emit → dispatcher fan-out → spoof-resistance gate (untrusted emissions dropped) → OTEL exporter recorders.

```

=== OpenClaw AI Safety Event Taxonomy — Simulation Run ===
Schema version: 1
Session: sim-session-abc12345

--- Stage 1: emit through trusted core path ---
  emit → ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal ... ok
  emit → ai_safety.tool_policy.decision ... ok
  emit → ai_safety.external_content.consumed ... ok
  emit → ai_safety.user_feedback.received ... ok
  emit → ai_safety.memory_context.selected ... ok
  emit → ai_safety.eval.result ... ok

--- Stage 2: dispatcher fan-out (trusted metadata attached) ---
  dispatch → ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal (seq=1, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.tool_policy.decision (seq=2, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.external_content.consumed (seq=3, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.user_feedback.received (seq=4, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.memory_context.selected (seq=5, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.eval.result (seq=6, trusted=true)

--- Stage 3: spoof-resistance gate (untrusted plugin path) ---
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.tool_policy.decision ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.external_content.consumed ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.user_feedback.received ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.memory_context.selected ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.eval.result ... submitted
  result: 0/6 untrusted ai_safety.* events reached the dispatcher (expected 0 — dropped by anti-spoofing gate)

--- Stage 4: OTEL exporter recorders (counter + low-cardinality attrs) ---
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "warn"
      openclaw.ai_safety.category = "indirect"
      openclaw.ai_safety.action_taken = "flagged"
      openclaw.ai_safety.source_type = "tool_output"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.tool_policy.decision += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.tool_name = "bash"
      openclaw.ai_safety.decision = "approval_required"
      openclaw.ai_safety.policy_source = "static_config"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "warn"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.external_content.consumed += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.source_type = "web_fetch"
      openclaw.ai_safety.trusted = "false"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.user_feedback.received += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.label = "correction"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.memory_context.selected += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.memory_type = "long_term"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.eval.result += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.eval_name = "source-trust-check"
      openclaw.ai_safety.passed = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "info"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"

All 6 events emitted through trusted path.
Dispatcher fan-out observed for 6/6 trusted events.
Spoof-resistance verified: 0/6 untrusted emissions dispatched.
Privacy fields verified: snippetHash and urlHash are sha256 — no raw content, and
neither hash appears in OTEL exporter attributes (leak check: passed).
```
</details>
